rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, outer_wall_s=1200, lr=0.0023, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=7, proj_kernel=7, img_kernel=9, proj_sx=1.0, proj_sy=2.0, proj_sr=0.02, img_sx=4.5, img_sy=4.5, img_sr=0.02, rationale=iter-17: ONE knob changed vs the iter-16 base (image-domain SPATIAL bilateral sigma img_sx/img_sy 3.5->4.5, BOTH x and y together = the isotropic image-domain spatial-extent sigma); all 18 other fields held IDENTICAL to demo_dl_dual_domain_bilateral_n2i_iter_16.json (img_kernel=9, img_n_bf=7, img_sr=0.02 LOOSE demo-correct, proj_n_bf=1, proj_kernel=7, proj_sx/sy=1.0/2.0, proj_sr=0.02, lr=2.3e-3, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, train_n=200, val_n=6, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42 -> identical seed=42 val split, directly comparable to iter-16 SSIM 0.8284 / hr 0.3283 / PSNR 20.12). THE PRE-REGISTERED iter-17 STEP: RE-LIBERATE THE NOW-UNLOCKED SIGMA. Read iter-15->16 BY SSIM (the surface the spatial-smoothing thread moves; hr stays pinned ~0.328-0.332 at the 64-view-FBP noise-floor ceiling): the kernel-widening thread is now in clear diminishing returns -- iter-15 img_kernel 5->7 gave SSIM 0.8035->0.8246 (+0.0211), but iter-16 img_kernel 7->9 gave only 0.8246->0.8284 (+0.0038, the gains shrank ~5x). FAILURE MODE / COUPLING DIAGNOSIS: across iter-13/14/15/16 the spatial-smoothing thread alternated tuning the continuous spatial SIGMA (img_sx/img_sy) and the discrete WINDOW (img_kernel), always raising whichever was the binding constraint. The sigma was last raised to 3.5 at iter-14 (inside a kernel=5 window) where it became WINDOW-CAPPED; iter-15/16 then widened the window 5->7->9. At kernel=9 the window is now +/-4px, so it can finally represent a Gaussian of sigma up to ~4 (since ~2*sigma=8px=full window) -- meaning the sigma=3.5 is no longer the binding constraint and there is fresh sigma headroom the window now admits. The kernel thread saturating (+0.0038) is the signal that the WINDOW is no longer the limiter; the live lever flips back to the SIGMA. HYPOTHESIS (img-spatial-3, sigma re-liberation): widening img_sx/img_sy 3.5->4.5 now that kernel=9 (+/-4px) admits a wider Gaussian lets each of the 7 image BFs average over the larger neighborhood the wider window permits, smoothing the broad post-FBP noise floor more (the demo-relevant axis since the spatial thread is the SSIM lever) while the unchanged LOOSE img_sr=0.02 keeps it edge-preserving -> may lift SSIM past iter-16 0.8284 on the SAME seed=42 split. Expect hr to stay pinned ~0.328-0.332 (this whole spatial thread is an SSIM-only structural-similarity lever bounded by the 64-view-FBP noise floor -- hr flat across iter-13/14/15/16). NOTE the coupling caution: at kernel=9 the +/-4px half-window is itself only marginally larger than sigma=4.5, so sigma=4.5 is again near the new window edge -- this iter tests whether the re-liberated sigma still has headroom inside the kernel=9 window or whether the spatial-smoothing thread has SATURATED (SSIM gain <0.005). If SSIM rises meaningfully, the sigma still has headroom and the alternating sigma<->kernel ladder continues (iter-18 would widen kernel 9->11); if SSIM SATURATES or regresses (gain <0.005), the image-domain spatial denoising is exhausted at the ~0.83 SSIM / ~0.33 hr substrate ceiling -- the 6-param bilateral cannot extract more than the 64-view (half of 128) FBP noise floor allows on this synthetic phantom substrate -- a clean ceiling-doc result toward iter-20. Chose img_sx/img_sy 3.5->4.5 (the EXPLICITLY pre-registered iter-16 next step -- 'iter-17 would then RE-LIBERATE the sigma img_sx/img_sy 3.5->4.5, now that kernel=9 admits a wider sigma') over (a) pushing img_kernel 9->11 (the kernel thread just saturated at +0.0038, and at kernel=9 the window already exceeds the current sigma=3.5, so the window is no longer the binding constraint -- widening it further with an unchanged sigma would be a wasted move; re-liberate the sigma the larger window now admits FIRST), (b) proj_sr/proj_kernel/proj_n_bf (whole proj domain confirmed flat at iter-11/12 -- symmetry trap, wasted), (c) img_sr (exhausted + substrate-confirmed WRONG-direction -- tightening to 0.0005 collapsed hr 0.3335->0.1998 at iter-4 -- FORBIDDEN, stays LOOSE 0.02), (d) img_n_bf/n_iter/pretrain_epochs/seed/val_n (all DEAD FLAT / variance-only, exhausted), (e) grad_clip (mandatory overflow guard at 1.0, not a quality lever). Held fixed at iter-16 values: img_kernel=9, img_n_bf=7, img_sr=0.02 (LOOSE, demo-correct), proj_n_bf=1, proj_kernel=7, proj_sr=0.02, proj_sx=1.0/proj_sy=2.0, lr=2.3e-3, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, train_n=200, val_n=6, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42. Wall: iter-16 ran 762 s at img_kernel=9; img_sx/img_sy are pure init sigma values inside the fixed img_kernel=9 window -> ZERO added compute, wall ~unchanged, comfortably under the 1800 s sbatch wall and the 1200 s outer_wall_s internal guard (under the 15-min budget). PER-IMAGE bilateral N2I, AGENT4CT_DATASET=phantoms; warm_start STAYS ON; do NOT revert to amortized; do NOT tighten img_sr.
